description:
Weapon Tooltip Preview
Because I like to see pewpew on the fly.

Source code

Required mods: LunaLib, LazyLib

Safe to add mid-game

No known mod conflicts

What is this?
Just scratching an old itch to see weapons firing on hover, because I can't be bothered to refit and go into the simulator just to isolate one firing pattern and see the satisfying pewpew.

Supports Weapons and Wings (and their weapons)
Supports all modded weapons (in theory)
Supports hullmod-gated weapons (in theory)
Supports system-gated weapons (in theory)
Supports GraphicsLib
Supports Fast Rendering
Hover in Cargo use generic ships (Wayfarer, Vigilance, Prometheus Mk.II) to cover all weapon types & sizes
Hover in Refit Area uses Fleet data to alter weapon stats in the preview (and mods altering it such as SiC, Ship Mastery...)
PD and AOE weapons trigger enemy missiles and wings to showcase their effects. This can be tweaked live in the preview.

Some Previews

From Cargo with generic ships... ... and Refit with actual stats

Works with Wings... ...and with Modded weapons... Showcases PD weapons with Missiles... ...and Wings the player can cycle through

Supports Hullmod-Weapons ...and Hullmod Requirements... ...and System-Gating

FAQ
Does it work with other Mods?
In theory, yes. It creates a dedicated CombatEngine and uses actual ship & weapon data. So any weapon data available in mods should work.

Do you plan to update it?
If there is a legit need to, yes.

Can I change the settings?
Besides a couple key bindings and default enemy, there's not much to change at the moment. If you have requests, please let me know.

AI use disclaimer
Some code in this mod was created using AI tools:

Code: Claude Code Opus 5.5

Everything was reviewed to the best of my ability and understanding. OpenGL shenanigans are above my paygrade so anyone willing to give it a second sanity-check is more than welcome.

For bug reports, include your game and mod versions, enabled mods and steps to reproduce the problem. A relevant log or screenshot helps!

aiDescription: Displays live animations of weapons, wings, and hullmod-gated systems when hovering over them in inventory or refit menus. Uses actual ship and fleet data to simulate combat scenarios, including PD and AOE interactions with enemy missiles.
